parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the active notch entry.

parameters.name: StartFreq
parameters.description: The initial frequency (in {{units}}) of a notch enabled in the spectrum of the local interface.

parameters.name: StopFreq
parameters.description: The final frequency (in {{units}}) of a notch enabled in the spectrum of the local interface.

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: The depth (in {{units}}) of a notch enabled in the spectrum of the local interface.

object.description: This object contains the list of active notches of the UPA interface. A UPA device can have notches in its spectrum, where no power is transmitted in a given part of the spectrum. These notches are typically located in amateur radio bands, to avoid interference. Note: All {{object}} entries can be enabled/disabled as a group using the {{param|#.ActiveNotchEnable}} parameter.
